bootstrap_policy: Preserve original prior movements; openingStock is their net balance, not a new purchase

warnings: Operational price is fixed per product because the application has no PriceHistory model.
Rotation-based inventory sizing is simulation metadata and must not be used as an ML feature.
Customer and supplier attributes are synthetic operational data, not initial ML features.

customers.pii_policy: Explicit synthetic names/phones; email and documentNumber forbidden.

cancellations.policy: Only additional synthetic non-credit sales; M5 demand remains valid.

selection_policy: Exact department quotas; observed diversity coverage; stable seed/item hash; no targets or TEST errors
